systems.name: 4.1 Module-Slot Upgrade System
systems.notes: Permanent upgrade system that replaces traditional item durability. Uses a slot metaphor at Tub's forge. Modules are unlocked via Ancient Blueprints found in world, and their effects directly modify player stats.

tasks.text: Permanent augments data structure (player stats modifiers)
tasks.notes: Design a flexible modifier system that can scale across phases.
Integrate with existing procedural GUI style; use inventory-like drag logic.

tasks.text: Unlock modules via Ancient Blueprint items
tasks.notes: Blueprints drop from chests, quests, and hidden chambers.

tasks.text: Apply stat effects: drill speed, fuel use, heat cap, etc.
tasks.notes: Must work seamlessly with existing player controller.

systems.name: 4.2 Camp Visual Growth System
systems.notes: The camp physically changes as the team banks ore. Forge expands, vacuum silos grow, brass towers appear. Serves as shared trophy case and visual progression marker.

tasks.text: Camp level tied to total ore banked
tasks.notes: Thresholds defined per level; broadcast to all clients.

tasks.text: Progressive 3D camp model reveals (forge, silos, towers)
tasks.notes: Swap or layer models; use phased construction animations.

tasks.text: Save/load camp level with world data
tasks.notes: Integrate with persistence layer from Phase 1.

systems.name: 4.3 Grub Loyalty & Ability Tree
systems.notes: Grub evolves from basic fetch/rescue to a capable assistant. Abilities unlock via resource investment or quests. State machine must handle new behaviours without breaking existing AI.

tasks.notes: Modular states that can be extended: idle, follow, fetch, rescue, drag, airdrop.

tasks.text: Base: fetch, rescue; Upgrades: speed, carry, drag, airdrop
tasks.notes: Upgrades gated by friendship level or materials.

systems.name: 4.4 Streamlined Crafting Interface
systems.notes: No grid crafting. All item creation happens at NPCs or specific stations via simple recipe lists. Recipes are learned automatically from blueprints. Focus on clarity and speed.

tasks.text: Eliminate grid; all crafting at NPCs/oven
tasks.notes: Redesign existing crafting UI to use button lists.
Show ingredients and output; one-click craft.
